column1: # Healing Wonders of Herbs, Herminia de Guzman-Ladion (Philippine Publishing House, Manila, 1985). Plant pages 61 to 134; remedies from the chapter "Common Ailments and Their Treatments", pages 12 to 45.
# Names are as printed. Uses are summarised, not quoted: ailment=part and form {amounts and dose, reworded}@page; ...
# English name, Filipino name, colours and native range are left empty where the plant already has an entry in curation.tsv.
